prohibited_capabilities.label: Organisation, team, unit or gym coaching runtime
prohibited_capabilities.governing_boundary: Actors remain individual athlete and coach only.

prohibited_capabilities.label: Resistance-training RPE prescription
prohibited_capabilities.governing_boundary: Resistance training remains percentage, fixed-load or bodyweight based.

prohibited_capabilities.label: Readiness, safety, suitability, risk or optimisation inference
prohibited_capabilities.governing_boundary: Product output remains factual and deterministic.

prohibited_capabilities.label: Coach, payment, admin or UI override of engine truth
prohibited_capabilities.governing_boundary: Engine legality and deterministic output remain independent of product state.

prohibited_capabilities.label: Diagnostic UI as a product workflow dependency
prohibited_capabilities.governing_boundary: The product UI must use public application routes only.

completion_rules: A function is not complete because a backend endpoint exists.
A function is not complete when it depends on PowerShell, direct API calls, database edits or diagnostic pages.
Core server records remain authoritative over local navigation cache.
Implemented functions require a visible route where a route is applicable and a direct test.
Prohibited capabilities require a named governing boundary.
